scope: Every original required case is retained. SFILE-05 remains the endpoint-family dependency; no option closes from boundary IDs alone.

boundaries.contract: Default /etc/resolv.conf is replaced by the first explicit option, including empty. Later nonempty occurrences prepend; later empty does not clear a nondefault list.
no-poll with >1 resolv paths is a configuration error unless no-resolv is set. no-resolv discards resolver-file sources but retains configured/file servers.
--test checks option grammar and cross-option constraints, but does not load resolver/server files (domain=# is a separately deferred config-time reader). Empty servers-file disables the source.

required_cases.requirement: repeated single servers-file option follows parser occurrence policy

boundaries.contract: Exact init emits these two options, touches the resolver file, mounts resolver parent and servers file, and reloads via procd plus signal. The family must use those interfaces.

required_cases.requirement: empty touched resolver transitions to populated
SIGHUP data reload without rereading main config

boundaries.contract: Resolver inotify is nonblocking/CLOEXEC, watches parent directories, and requires parent existence. A missing leaf is allowed. no-poll still installs the watch at startup.
Follow leaf symlink chains at watch setup, resolving relative targets against each symlink parent; stop at missing target; enforce MAXSYMLINKS. Retain original configured path for reload opens.
The exact build requires a directory separator for resolver watch setup; relative bare filenames and root-parent edge paths require exact startup error observation, not silent path normalization.
Only matching close-write or moved-to names trigger forced resolver selection. Delete alone and unrelated basename do not trigger. Match all configured entries sharing a watch descriptor.

required_cases.requirement: close-write then delete before event drain

boundaries.contract: Global inotify filename filtering ignores dotfiles, trailing tilde, and #name# even when configured as resolver files. Zero-name events are ignored.

required_cases.requirement: queue/ignored/directory-self event does not invent reload

boundaries.contract: Watch paths are fixed at startup. Symlink retarget or parent replacement does not automatically recreate watches in this exact C build.

required_cases.requirement: retarget symlink then write new target
event at old target reopens original configured name
recovery only where an actual C trigger exists

boundaries.contract: Forced selection scans all existing candidates and selects greatest whole-second mtime, with strict greater-than comparison and configured list order breaking ties. It does not merge all files.

required_cases.requirement: equal mtimes last explicit declaration wins
write older candidate while newer remains

boundaries.contract: During a forced scan missing entries have remembered mtime reset and are skipped. An unforced route-trigger scan can detect disappearance and force reselection.

required_cases.requirement: previous winner missing then matching event
all missing preserves prior servers if no file was opened

boundaries.contract: Recognize exact nameserver and server tokens. Split whitespace; only the next token is the address. Accept IPv4 and IPv6; ignore malformed tokens and unrelated directives.
IPv6 resolver scope uses interface-name lookup; unknown names yield scope zero without a parser fatal error. IPv4 scoped tokens are ignored.

required_cases.requirement: scope preserved in upstream socket destination

boundaries.contract: Open failure returns before source marking and retains previous resolver rules. Successful empty or all-invalid reads mark and remove resolver-sourced rules, preserving other source banks.

required_cases.requirement: partial successful lines before stream error

boundaries.contract: Empty reload rebuilds the server array and resets candidate mtime; retry occurs only on actual triggers in HAVE_INOTIFY mode. Do not invent a one-second timer from the non-inotify branch.
Replace only SERV_FROM_RESOLV rows; retain inline server/local/address and servers-file rows. Keep default resolver order and duplicate occurrences rather than deduplicating addresses.

required_cases.requirement: inline global plus resolver global both eligible

boundaries.contract: server=/domain/# refers to all ordinary global upstreams, skips default address literals, and is not synonymous with resolver-file-only servers. Keep implicit global tier visible to the local answer path.
check_servers ignores IPv4 0.0.0.0 and upstream socket addresses equal to a local DNS listener, while retaining valid independent endpoints.
no-poll loads its sole file on INIT and SIGHUP, suppressing automatic resolver changes despite receiving inotify readiness.

required_cases.requirement: write without HUP retains old upstream

boundaries.contract: In ordinary polling mode SIGHUP does not explicitly reread resolv files; in no-poll mode route events also do not reread. Separate file mtime change from real trigger.

required_cases.requirement: modify via event-suppressed path then HUP ordinary mode

boundaries.contract: Read servers-file on INIT and SIGHUP only. It is not inotify watched and ordinary resolv changes do not reload it unless clear-on-reload invokes broader hooks that still exclude read_servers_file.

required_cases.requirement: clear-on-reload resolv event still not servers-file reload

boundaries.contract: Only server and rev-server directives are allowed. Preserve common lexical quotes/comments/whitespace. Invalid lines log and continue, including illegal supported options.

required_cases.requirement: malformed line followed by valid line

boundaries.contract: File open failure keeps old SERV_FROM_FILE bank. A successfully opened file replaces the bank even if empty/all invalid; errors are nonfatal at startup and reload.

required_cases.requirement: relative dash path is literal file not stdin

boundaries.contract: SERV_FROM_FILE applies to both server local-only/default markers and numeric endpoints; rev-server inherits file provenance. Removed file rules must not delete inline local/address/reverse routes.
servers-file inherits hostname, IPv6 scope and @source/interface/port semantics from server/rev-server. This is a known endpoint-family dependency; numeric-only testing cannot close the full option.

required_cases.requirement: resolver failure line then valid line

boundaries.contract: Runtime parse errors retain valid parsed rows and do not roll back to the old complete source bank. Main config remains immutable across SIGHUP.

required_cases.requirement: one invalid row only removes old bank
change main config on disk plus HUP does not consume it

boundaries.contract: clear-on-reload runs the full clear_cache_and_reload hook after a successful noninitial resolver reload; an empty/failed reload does not invoke it. Success is parsed-at-least-one, before later endpoint filtering.
Full reload refreshes /etc/hosts/addn-hosts and DHCP data banks, ethers, lease names, leasefile and DNS; it is more than dropping dynamic cache. Reuse existing owner hook with its order.

required_cases.requirement: hosts modified silently then successful resolver event
ordinary SIGHUP clears regardless of flag

boundaries.contract: SIGHUP already performs one full reload before no-poll/servers-file reads; no extra clear-on-reload invocation should duplicate lease/script side effects.

required_cases.requirement: script event count and cache insertion counters
repeated signals coalesced by existing owner

boundaries.contract: Marked C server slots are reused by source-update order and matching domain, not endpoint address identity. Same-domain endpoint mutation may preserve the server slot/pending reference.

required_cases.requirement: same count endpoint change with delayed reply
same domain reused from each source bank
retain source-independent metrics and health as C does

boundaries.contract: Only genuinely removed server slots call server_gone: cancel outstanding frecs sent_to that slot and detach random-socket references. Do not reset every UDP transaction on reload.
Rebuild route groups without renumbering live server identities incorrectly. Last declaration/list order controls strict-order; stale groups cannot route new queries.

required_cases.requirement: updating resolv after servers-file changes global source interleaving order exactly as C, rather than a fixed source-bank sort

boundaries.contract: In the image init -k mode, existing TCP children retain fork-time server/local snapshots; new accepted connections use refreshed parent state. Rust sessions must retain this distinction. Debug/no-daemon C does not fork and belongs to its separate mode contract.

required_cases.requirement: open TCP before update query after update
TCP query already pending during update
cache publication from existing TCP after source change

boundaries.contract: Separate file bank publication from full service reset: listener sockets, leases, helper, TFTP, counters and unrelated cache remain live unless the exact reload hook changes them.

required_cases.requirement: DNS and DHCP traffic during repeated reload
FD count returns after old upstream cancellation

boundaries.contract: Distinguish startup watch failure from later nonfatal file read failures. Preserve exact exit/status/diagnostic category and clean all opened descriptors.

required_cases.requirement: EMFILE opening file after service live

boundaries.contract: Event processing and file parsing must yield to the single poll owner; preserve all byte/line data needed for C semantics. Hostile nonregular paths may not block the owner and require explicit boundary evidence.

required_cases.requirement: large regular file with concurrent DNS p95 witness
ENOSPC confirmed harness error not product mismatch

boundaries.contract: The family mirror records both client answers and per-upstream receives; stale caches or equal answer data cannot hide missing reloads. Freeze --test/startup/runtime identities separately.
Final closure requires exact-image paired evidence plus candidate source/ELF identity and size increment; implementation-only or numeric-only endpoint coverage does not close the option.
